summary.headline: Astrological Chapters 108–130
summary.text: Catalog entries 108–130 from a Venetian astrological codex, covering house rulers, destroyers, predominators, time divisions, nativities, conception, parents, brothers, occupations, travel, marriage, diseases, animals, dignity, victory, and horary questions. Valens, Dorotheus, Antigonus, Maximus, Rhetorius, Hermes, and Hephaestion are cited, with references to Paris 2506 and edited appendices.
